m: 1. उपोढ mfn. (in some cases not to be distinguished from 2. उपोढ, q.v. under उपोह्) brought near, effected, appeared, Rājat.; Daś. &c.;
near (in time and space), Mālav.; Kum.
उपोढ For 1. See उप-√ वह्, p. 206, col. 3
for 2. See उपोह्, next col.
2. उपोढ mfn. (in some cases not to be distinguished from 1. उपोढ, p. 206, col. 3) pushed or driven near, near
brought near, caused to appear, produced, Śak. 177 a; Vikr. &c.
brought about, advanced, commenced
heaped up, accumulated, gathered, Śak. 111 a.
a: उपोढ — p. p. 1 Collected, accumulated, increased, stored up; उपोढतपसां Ś. 5. 7; ˚बलस्य ते M. 5. 1; V. 2. 7; so ˚मदः, ˚हर्षः &c. --2 Brought near, proximate, near; Ki. 17. 54, 13. 23. --3 Arrayed for battle (as an army). --4 Begun, commenced; उपोढशब्दा न रथांगनेमयः Ś. 7. 10 causing sound. --5 Married. --6 A battle-array.
उपोढ — p. p. 1 Brought near. --2 Advanced, begun.

m: उपोद् (उप-√ उद्) P. -उनत्ति, to wet, moisten, ŚBr. i.
उपोद्-आ-√ हृ P. -हरति, to quote in addition, mention a further quotation, PārGṛ.
उपोद्-आ-√ सृप् P. (impf. -आसर्पत्) to creep out towards, AitBr. vi, 1, 1; 3.
उपोदासृप्त mfn. crept out towards, ŚBr. vii.

v: upodDAtaH

m: उपोद्-धन् (उप-उद्-√ हन्), Caus. -घातयति, to speak of at the beginning, introduce, begin, commence, Sāy. on ŚBr. xi, 7, 2, 8; Mall. on Śiś. i, 40; 42 Comm. on BṛĀrUp.

s: puM, (upa samIpe udDananam । upa + ut + han + GaY .) udAharaRam । ityamaraH ॥ AramBaH । iti BarataH ॥ saNgativiSezaH । yaTA, -- “saprasaNga upodGAto hetutAvasarastaTA । nirvvAhakEkakAryyatve zoQA saNgatirizyate” ॥ tallakzaRaM yaTA, -- “cintAM prakftasidDArTAmupodGAtaM vidurbbuDAH” । ityanumitO jagadISatarkAlaNkAraH ॥

any observation or episodical narrative inserted by the way, Kathās.
anything begun
an example, apposite argument or illustration, W.
analysis, the ascertainment of the elements of anything, W.
a: उपोद्घातः — 1 A beginning, commencement --2 An introduction, a preface. --3 An example, an apposite argument or illustration. --4 An occasion, medium, means; तत्प्रतिच्छंदकमुपोद्घातेन माधवांतिकमुपेयात् Māl. 1. --5 Analysis, ascertaining the elements of anything. --6 Alluding to, mentioning; Mu. 3.

m: उपोद्-घात—पाद m. N. of the third part of the Vāyu-purāṇa.
उपोदीका v.l. for उपोदिका.

a: उपोद्बलयति — Den. P. To confirm, strengthen.

m: उपोद्बलित mfn. confirmed, asserted, Nīlak.
उपोद्गृह्य ind.p. holding together and holding upwards, Gobh. ii, 2, 16.

m: उपोद्-√ यम् P. -यच्छति, to erect by supporting or propping, ĀśvŚr.; ŚāṅkhŚr.; MānŚr.

उपोह् (उप- √ 1. ऊह्; cf. उप-√ वह्) P. उपोहति, to push or pull or draw near, R.; to drive near, impel towards, BhP.; to push under, insert, KātyŚr.; to add, accumulate; to bring near, cause to appear, produce; Pass. उपोह्यते, to draw near, approach (as a point of time), MBh.
a: उपोह् — {c1c} P. (उप-उह्) 1 To propel, push or impel towards; उपोह्य रुचिरां नावं Rām.; so धनुः. --2 To push under, insert, कूर्चावधस्तादुपोह्य Kātyāyana. --3 To bring near, produce: connected with उपवह् in this sense; q. v. --4 To accumulate, collect. --pass. 1 To be brought about. --2 To advance, begin.

m: उपोह m. the act of accumulating, heaping up, AV. iii, 24, 7.
उपोह्य ind.p. having pushed near &c.
उपोक्त-वती f. (scil. ऋच्) a verse containing any form of उप-√ वच्, ĀśvŚr. ii, 17, 19.
उपोक्ष् (उप-√ उक्ष्) P. -उक्षति, to sprinkle in addition, ŚBr.; KātyŚr.

उपोलव N. of a plant, Kauś.
उपोन्दन n. wetting, watering, ib.
उपोन्-√ नी (उप-उद्-√ नी) P. -नयति, to lead up towards, ŚBr. ii.
उपोप-√ धा Ā. (Pot. -दधीत) to bring near or procure in addition to, RV. viii, 74, 9.
उपोप-परा-√ मृश् P. (Impv. 2. sg. -मृश) to touch closely, RV. i, 126, 7.
उपोप-√ विश् P. -विशति, to sit down or take a seat by the side of, sit down near to (acc.), ŚāṅkhŚr.; Gobh.; ChUp.; MBh. &c.
उपोप-√ या
उपोपयात mfn. approached, come near, MBh. iii.

उपोत्थाय ind.p. having risen towards, advancing to meet &c.
उपोत्थित mfn. risen up towards, approached, come near, VS. viii, 55; VPrāt. vi, 29.

उपोत्-√ क्रम् (उप-उद्-√ क्रम्) P. (impf. 3. pl. उपोद्-अक्रामन्) to go up or ascend towards (acc.), ŚBr. i, iii, iv.
उपोत्-√ सद् (उप-उद्-√ सद्) P. to set out or depart towards, ŚBr.
उपोत्-√ सिच् (उप-उद्-√ सिच्) P. -सिञ्चति, to pour out upon, ŚBr. iii.
उपोत्त mfn. moistened, wet, TS. iv.
